name: book_appointment
description: Call this once the caller has picked one of the two slots you offered from check_availability. Creates the real appointment on the business's calendar. Use the exact start_iso/end_iso from the slot they chose — never invent your own times here.

start_iso.description: The exact start_iso value from the slot the caller chose in check_availability's response

end_iso.description: The exact end_iso value from the slot the caller chose in check_availability's response

summary.description: One or two sentence summary of the job for the technician
